Meet the Team

Emerald mascot

Gabe

Gabe is a Computer Science & Engineering student who would really like to be good enough at programming and development to be a game designer one day. He has lived in Ohio his whole life, and currently lives out in the country near Alliance, Ohio, with his parents and younger brother Quinn. He enjoys video games, board games, reading, and anything that engrosses him in a good story. In addition to this, he has dabbled in writing, acting, and sketch comedy. His claim to fame is that he has exactly one IMDb credit. Above all, Gabe’s personal mission is to spread the gospel of Jesus to everyone he can.
